If PBT-GF is used as the support material for itself, please remove the support structure as soon as the model cools down.
Otherwise the support structure can be permanently bonded to the model due to excessive moisture absorption, which will make the support hard to remove.
After the printing process, it is recommended to dry the model in the oven at 80-100°C for 1-3 hours to increase the strength of the model.
The has a high temperature resistant with excellent rigidity and tensile strength.

polymer.basis: BASF Ultradur B 4500, the unreinforced uncoloured polybutylene terephthalate: density 1300 kg/m3 (ISO 1183), melting temperature 223 C by DSC (ISO 11357-1/-3) and an equilibrium water uptake of 0.5 % at 23 C (Product Information 02/2026, p. 2). Celanese's Crastin FG6130 agrees at 1300 kg/m3 and 225 C. It crystallises fast enough that a printed part's heat resistance follows its melting point, as the other semicrystalline polyesters here do; 0.5 % is not the uptake that moves a polyamide's modulus, so the row records none.
